The World Development Indicators releases the archive holds

Source: R/worldbank.R
wdi_vintages.Rd

Every release in the World Bank's WDI Database Archives (API source 57), oldest first, so a figure can be pinned to the release it came from with vintage = in fetch_indicator(), country_data() and world_data(). The list is fetched once a day per session.

Usage

wdi_vintages()

Value

A tibble of vintage ("2024-07"), id (the API's "202407") and label (the API's own, "2024 Jul"). On a failed request, a warning and no rows, unless options(countryatlas.strict = TRUE).

See also

compare_vintages()

Examples

# \donttest{
tail(wdi_vintages())
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   vintage id     label   
#>   <chr>   <chr>  <chr>   
#> 1 2025-10 202510 2025 Oct
#> 2 2025-12 202512 2025 Dec
#> 3 2026-01 202601 2026 Jan
#> 4 2026-02 202602 2026 Feb
#> 5 2026-04 202604 2026 Apr
#> 6 2026-07 202607 2026 Jul
# }
